exercises: more than one variable in a single server URL, including one with no enum and one with no description
note: The three variables differ deliberately: branch has both enum and description, basePath has a description and no enum, version has an enum and no description. An implementation that assumes both keys are present will fail on two of the three.

expected.assert: version renders with its enum and no description, rather than a blank description row.
